name: Outdoor 582 Pure Cube Sauna
description:
The Outdoor 582 Pure Cube Sauna - 5 Person is a charming and sophisticated design that features 3 large window panels on the front wall and the door on either the left or right side wall. Create a calm and relaxing atmosphere with the optional semi-privacy panels that still have the double pane glass with a fixed cedar grill on the outside. Relax and rejuvenate with your family or friends in this clean and modern sauna.

•	Comfortably Seats 4-5
•	5.5' W x 8.3' L x 7.6 H (173x254x231cm)
•	Crafted from Canadian Clear or Knotty Red Cedar
•	Glass Sauna Door
•	2-Tier Benches
•	Tempered Glass Windows

* Please note: Electric heaters require a certified electrician to hardwire the unit directly into your electrical panel.
